notes: τῷ before νῦν αἰῶνι is `aligned` to the supplied demonstrative *this* under rule 60, which names this very phrase as its leading example.

Τοῖς keeps the discontinuous *them … that* because its complement is an adjective with no verb to carry the relativizer, and the copula splits off onto πλουσίοις under rule 53 — the same test the chapter applies at 6:19 and 6:20.
The supplied possessive *their* stays inside the ἠλπικέναι periphrasis, no source word standing available to take it (rules 20, 76).
Both supplied complementizers sit on the infinitives they introduce under rule 85, not on παράγγελλε.
